Other areas of progress include improved diffusion methods for generating and editing media, reinforcement-learning approaches that refine model behavior using feedback, and smaller models that achieve strong results through more targeted training and optimization. Researchers are also working on methods to improve reliability, reduce computational costs, and evaluate limitations. Together, these algorithmic advances are expanding the practical uses of artificial intelligence, though performance and safety still depend on the task and how a system is deployed.
